questions.question: In Computer terminology, what is the full form of IDN?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Internationalized Domain Name**__.

 
• An **Internationalized Domain Name (IDN)** is a domain name that includes characters used in the local representation of languages that are not written with the twenty-six letters of the basic Latin alphabet "a-z".
 
• This allows domain names to be registered in languages and scripts such as Arabic, Chinese, Cyrillic, Hindi, and others.
 
• IDNs are an important step towards making the internet more accessible to people worldwide, allowing them to use **domain names in their native languages**.
 
• The use of IDNs helps in overcoming language barriers and promotes global internet inclusivity.

 
• **History of IDNs**

 
 
• The concept of Internationalized Domain Names was first proposed in 1996.
 
• The first implementations of IDNs were available in 1998 and 1999, but they were not standardized and interoperable.
 
• In **2003**, the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) published the **first standard for IDNs**, called the Internationalizing Domain Names in Applications (IDNA).
 
• Since then, several updates and improvements have been made to the IDNA standard.
 
 
 
• **Technical Aspects of IDNs**
 
 
• IDNs are stored in the Domain Name System (DNS) as ASCII strings using a system called Punycode.
 
• Punycode is a way to represent Unicode characters using only the ASCII subset supported by the DNS.
 
• For example, the Chinese domain name "例子.测试" is encoded as "xn--fsq.xn--0zwm56d" in Punycode.
 
• This ensures that IDNs are compatible with the existing DNS infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Challenges and Adoption**
 
 
• Despite the benefits, the adoption of IDNs has been slow due to various challenges, including browser and application compatibility, user awareness, and security concerns.
 
• Phishing attacks can exploit visually similar characters in different scripts to create deceptive domain names.
 
• Efforts are ongoing to improve the security and usability of IDNs.

questions.question:
Find the median of the data 40, 50, 30, 20, 80, 70, 90, 50. Next, if 30 is replaced by 120, find the new median.

The mean of the two medians found is ________
questions.solution:
Given:

Original data set is 40, 50, 30, 20, 80, 70, 90, 50.

Then 30 is replaced by 120.

Formula Used:

Median for an even number of observations = (Value at (n/2) position + Value at ((n/2)+1) position) / 2.

Calculation

Original Set: 40, 50, 30, 20, 80, 70, 90, 50 Ordered Set: 20, 30, 40, 50, 50, 70, 80, 90

⇒ Median = (50 + 50) / 2 = 100 / 2

⇒ Median = 50 After Replacing 30 with 120: New Set: 20, 40, 50, 50, 70, 80, 90, 120

⇒ New Median = (50 + 70) / 2 = 120 / 2

⇒ New Median = 60

Mean of Two Medians: = Mean = (50 + 60) / 2 = 110 / 2

⇒ Mean = 55

questions.question: How will you write 5.26 hours in hours, minutes and seconds?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

5.26 hours

**Formula Used:**

1 hour = 60 minutes

1 minute = 60 seconds

**Calculation:**

⇒ 5.26 hours × 60 minutes/hour = 315.6 minutes

⇒ 315.6 minutes × 60 seconds/minute = 18936 seconds

⇒ 18936 seconds ÷ 60 seconds/minute = 315.6 minutes

⇒ 315.6 minutes ÷ 60 minutes/hour = 5.26 hours

**Therefore, 5.26 hours = 5 hours 15 minutes 36 seconds.**

questions.question: Two poles are standing on the ground. The distances between their feet and their tops are 48 m and 50 m respectively. If the height of the small pole is 10 m, find the height of the big pole.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the **Pythagorean triplet** (7, 24, 25) scaled by a factor of 2: (14, 48, 50).

The distance between feet (Base) is 48 m and the distance between tops (Hypotenuse) is 50 m.

Thus, the **difference in height** (Perpendicular) must be 14 m.

Height of the **big pole** = Height of **small pole** + **Difference** = 10 + 14 = 24 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of small pole (h₁) = 10 m

Distance between feet (d) = 48 m

Distance between tops (s) = 50 m

**Formula Used:**

According to **Pythagorean Theorem**: s² = d² + (h₂ − h₁)²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b35b6b7419d52bb7e23648829911f11b8218c3152aed38c463e1ad08a38ead13.png] 

Let the height of the **big pole** be h₂.

⇒ (h₂ − 10)² + 48² = 50²

⇒ (h₂ − 10)² = 50² − 48²

⇒ (h₂ − 10)² = (50 − 48)(50 + 48)

⇒ (h₂ − 10)² = 2 × 98 = 196

⇒ h₂ − 10 = √196

⇒ h₂ − 10 = 14

⇒ h₂ = 14 + 10 = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Triplets

These are sets of three positive integers a, b, and c such that a² + b² = c². Common triplets include (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (8, 15, 17), and (7, 24, 25). Any multiple of a triplet is also a triplet.

Application in Heights

When two parallel vertical objects stand on horizontal ground, the **slant distance** between their tops, the **horizontal distance** between their bases, and the **difference in their heights** always form a **right-angled triangle**.

Algebraic Identity

Using the identity a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b) simplifies calculations involving squares of large numbers, especially in geometry problems.</p

questions.question:
A train starts with full number of passengers. At the first stop, it drops one third of the passengers and takes in 96 more.

At the second stop, it drops one half of the passengers onboard and takes in 12 more. If there are 248 passengers onboard traveling to third station, then with how many passengers did the train start?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of passengers onboard traveling to the third station = 248

**Formula Used:**

Number of passengers at the second stop = Number of passengers onboard traveling to the third station × 2

**Calculation:**

After 2nd stop:

⇒ Before +12, passengers = 248 - 12 = 236

As 236 is half the passengers after 1st stop,

⇒ Passengers after 1st stop = 236 × 2 = 472

Passengers after 1st stop:

⇒ 2/3 × original + 96 = 472

Solving for original:

⇒ 2/3 × original = 472 - 96 = 376 ⇒ original = 376 × 3/2 = 564

**The train started with 564 passengers.**

questions.question: A carriage driving in a fog passed a man who was walking at the speed of 3 km/h in the same direction. He could see the carriage for 4 min and it was visible to him up to a distance of 100 m. What was the speed of the carriage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Man's speed = 3 km/h

Carriage visible for 4 min = 4/60 h = 1/15 h

Distance visible = 100 m = 0.1 km

**Formula Used: **

Relative speed = Distance / Time

**Calculation:**

Distance = 0.1 km, Time = 1/15 h

⇒ Relative speed = 0.1 / (1/15) = 0.1 × 15 = 1.5 km/h

⇒ Speed of carriage relative to man = 1.5 km/h

Given man's speed is 3 km/h:

⇒ Speed of carriage = Speed of man + Relative speed = 3 + 1.5 = 4.5 km/h.

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**

__
 
• **RAM (Random Access Memory)** is a type of **volatile memory**, which means that it **loses its data **when the power is turned off.
 
• It is used by the computer to **store data **that is being used currently or frequently accessed applications and processes.
 
• RAM allows data to be read and written quickly to and from the memory, making it essential for the smooth operation of active applications and the operating system.
 
• Unlike non-volatile memory such as ROM (Read-Only Memory), **EPROM **(Erasable Programmable Read-Only Memory), or **PROM **(Programmable Read-Only Memory), which **retain data **even when the power is off, RAM requires power to maintain the stored information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Types of RAM:**

 
 
• **DRAM (Dynamic RAM):** Needs to be refreshed thousands of times per second.
 
• **SRAM (Static RAM):** Faster and more reliable than DRAM, does not need to be refreshed as often, but is more expensive.
 
 
 
• **Usage of RAM:**
 
 
• RAM is used by the system to load the operating system, application programs, and currently used data so that they can be quickly reached by the device's processor.
 
• In modern computers, RAM is typically installed in DIMM (Dual Inline Memory Module) slots on the motherboard.
 
 
 
• **Impact of RAM on System Performance:**
 
 
• Having more RAM can significantly improve system performance, especially when running multiple applications simultaneously.
 
• Insufficient RAM can lead to slower system performance and increased usage of the hard drive for virtual memory, which is much slower than accessing data from RAM.

questions.question: Find the value of a² + b² + c² - 2ab + 2ac - 2bc, if a = x + y, b = x - y and c = 2x - 1
questions.solution:

a = x + y

b = x - y

c = 2x - 1

**Formula Used**

(a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

**Calculation**

⇒ a² + b² + c² - 2ab + 2ac - 2bc

⇒ (x + y)² + (x - y)² + (2x - 1)² - 2(x + y)(x - y) + 2(x + y)(2x - 1) - 2(x - y)(2x - 1)

⇒ x² + 2xy + y² + x² - 2xy + y² + 4x² - 4x + 1 - 2(x² - y²) + 4x(2x - 1) - 4y(2x - 1)

⇒ 6x² + 2y² - 4x + 1 - 2x² + 2y² + 8x² - 4x - 8xy + 4y

⇒ 2x² + 4y² - 8x + 5

⇒ (2x)² + (2y)² - 2×2x×2y + 5

⇒ (2x - 2y)² + 5

⇒ (2x + 2y - 1)²

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**

Each edge of a cube is increased by 50%.

Original surface area of cube = 6 × (edge)².

New edge = original edge × 1.50.

New surface area = 6 × (new edge)².

Percentage increase in surface area = [(New surface area - Original surface area) / Original surface area] × 100.

questions.question: Two trains start at the same time from two stations and proceed towards each other at the speeds of 20 km/h and 25 km/h respectively. When they meet, it is found that one train has travelled 80 km more than the other. Find the distance between the two stations.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **speeds** of two trains = 20 : 25 = 4 : 5.

When **time** is constant, the ratio of **distance** covered is equal to the ratio of speeds = 4 : 5.

Difference in **distance** parts = 5 − 4 = 1 unit → 80 km.

Total **distance** between stations = Sum of ratio parts = 4 + 5 = 9 units.

Total **distance** = 9 × 80 = 720 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 720 km.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Speed** of Train 1 = 20 km/h

**Speed** of Train 2 = 25 km/h

Difference in **distance** covered = 80 km

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05dba94b08e1d5b1847189d8e829d4e06f2b46e8ddddae9ca96695cfe35c5688.png] 

Let the **time** taken by the trains to meet be **t** hours.

⇒ **Distance** covered by Train 1 = Speed × Time = 20 × t

⇒ **Distance** covered by Train 2 = Speed × Time = 25 × t

⇒ According to the question, Train 2 covered 80 km more than Train 1.

⇒ 25t − 20t = 80

⇒ 5t = 80

⇒ t = 16 hours

⇒ Total **distance** between stations = (Speed₁ × t) + (Speed₂ × t)

⇒ Total distance = (20 + 25) × 16

⇒ Total distance = 45 × 16 = 720 km

**∴ The correct answer is 720 km.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two bodies move towards each other, their **relative speed** is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂). If they move in the same direction, it is the difference (S₁ − S₂).

Distance-Speed Relationship

For a constant **time**, the **distance** is directly proportional to the **speed** (D₁/D₂ = S₁/S₂).

Meeting Time Formula

Time taken to meet = Initial **distance** between objects ÷ **Relative Speed**.</p

questions.question: We hear others speaking to us from adjacent rooms due to ________ of sound waves.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **diffraction**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Sound waves** spread like light when they move through a narrow aperture.** If the aperture is small, sound waves spread out in all directions.**
 
• Therefore, sound can be heard around the **corner of the corridor.**
 
• The diffraction of lower frequencies in the human voice allows you to hear if someone is talking in another room or around the corner.
 
• When sound waves diffract, they bend around obstacles or spread out through narrow openings.
 
• If the wavelength of the sound is smaller than the obstacle, almost** no diffraction will take place.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Reflection: **Reflection of sound waves into new directions by a surface is known as 'reflection of sound'. It follows the same laws as for reflection of light: the angle of incidence is equal to the angle of reflection, and the incident wave, normal wave, and reflected wave all lie in the same plane. Sound waves can be reflected by large, hard, smooth, vertical, or faraway surfaces like walls, buildings, etc.

 

 
• **Refraction**: It is the change of direction of a sound wave on passing from one medium to another. It is accompanied by a change in speed and wavelength of the waves. If medium is changed, speed of the wave will also be changed. For example sound waves refract when they travel over water. It does not change medium rather it travels through a medium with different properties. Thus, waves will encounter refraction and change its direction. Sound waves travel slower in cooler air than they do in warmer air. Because of this the portion of the wave front far above the water speeds ahead. Subsequently, the direction of the wave changes, refracting downwards towards the water.

questions.question: The simple interest on a given sum of money for two years would have been Rs. 240 more had the rate of interest per annum been 3% higher. Find the initial sum invested.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **additional interest** percentage for 2 years at 3% higher rate = 3% × 2 = 6%.

This 6% of the **Principal** is equal to Rs. 240.

Principal (100%) = (240 ÷ 6) × 100 = 40 × 100 = 4,000.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 4,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/851bea666c3e0dfeabf02e6f73ad1970f4d6947e84b8a413c73eeecb81263899.png] 

**Given:**

**Time (T)** = 2 years

**Increase in Rate (ΔR)** = 3% per annum

**Increase in Simple Interest (ΔSI)** = Rs. 240

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Change in Simple Interest (ΔSI) = (P × ΔR × T) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ 240 = (P × 3 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ 240 = (P × 6) ÷ 100

⇒ 240 × 100 = 6P

⇒ 24000 = 6P

⇒ P = 24000 ÷ 6

⇒ P = 4,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 4,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Concept

Simple interest is calculated only on the **Principal** amount, meaning the interest earned remains constant every year if the rate and principal are unchanged.

Total Amount Formula

The final **Amount (A)** after T years is given by A = P + SI, where P is the **Initial Sum**.

Direct Proportionality

In **Simple Interest**, the interest earned is directly proportional to the **Principal**, the **Rate**, and the **Time** duration.</p

⇒ 693k ≤ 1388

⇒ k ≤ 1388 / 693

⇒ k ≤ 2 (Approx)

Max value = 693 × 2 + 3 = 1386 + 3 = 1389

**So, the least number that must be subtracted from 1391 to meet the conditions is 2.**
